sentences: Good morning, GPS Tronic, how can I help you?
First, turn off the monitor and wait ten seconds.
I can be there on Tuesday at nine in the morning.
I'm really sorry about the delay.
The display keeps turning off, so we ran a diagnostic test.
We've replaced the cable and installed a firmware update.
The part number is A, G, four, four, oh, seven, two.
We're interested in becoming a local dealer in Brazil.

grammar.title: Revisão Geral A2 → B1: Do balcão da oficina à Agrishow
rules: Atendimento e Suporte (Aulas 1–9): Presente ("It keeps turning off"), Imperativo ("First, turn off… Don't pull…") e Agendamento ("on Tuesday at nine").
Oficina e Entrega (Aulas 3, 11, 12): Passado ("The cable was loose") + Present Perfect para o resultado pronto ("We've replaced it and tested everything").
Prazos e Fornecedores (Aulas 4, 7, 10, 13): Comparativos ("cheaper / more reliable"), "I'm afraid…" e números/datas ("two hundred dollars, on October third").
Feiras e Parcerias (Aula 14): "I'm interested in becoming a dealer" + "We're looking for a partner" + "Let's keep in touch."
